cover_letter:
Dear Jitendra and the Kreative Media team,

I'm applying for the AI Automation Expert (n8n / Make / Zapier / AI Agents) role. Turning a creative brief into production-ready output faster is exactly the kind of pipeline I like to build.

Over the last two years I've designed workflow ecosystems in n8n, Make, Zapier and GoHighLevel that took over 60% of manual tasks off teams and cut project turnaround by 35%. I've plugged OpenAI and Anthropic models into those flows for smart routing, which reduced manual data entry by 75%. One recent build: an n8n pipeline that pulls news from RSS feeds, summarises it with Llama 3.1 on Groq, archives it to Airtable and Google Docs, and sends a daily digest to email and Slack, for under $1 a month to run.

For an agency, onboarding, delivery and reporting are where automation pays off most. I've built client onboarding and lifecycle automations with zero lead leakage, and self-updating KPI dashboards in Python, Streamlit and Power BI that replaced manual weekly reports. I map the process before I build, document every workflow, and set up failure alerts and cost tracking.

I work from Lagos (UTC+1) and am comfortable overlapping with Indian and US hours. You can see live examples of my work at theresakaramor.lovable.app.

I'd welcome a call to talk about the automations on your roadmap.

Kind regards,
Theresa Karamor
